tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Paper-grey in light, near-black in dark; carries the blueprint grid.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: widgets, check cards, figure plates.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells inside panels: slider track, readout well, inactive option fill, code spans.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and all control outlines. Body copy on bg, surface, surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: standfirst, figure captions, h3 kicker numerals. On bg, surface, surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: meta row, mono labels, axis labels (13px). On bg, surface, surface-2 at ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Non-text only: ticks, disabled outlines, placeholder marks. ≥3:1 on bg in light; decorative in dark. Never body text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, the blueprint grid, table rules, dividers. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal orange. Links, active slider fill, the check label, the one hot mark per figure. As text on bg/surface ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn ON an accent fill (label chips, primary button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid 2px outline, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on bg, surface, surface-2 and against accent fills.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Correct / healthy. Always paired with a word (CORRECT, READY). Text on bg and surface ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Wrong / failed. Magenta-red, kept off the accent's orange. Always paired with a word (NOT QUITE, CRASHLOOP).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution / pending. Always paired with a word (PENDING). Text on bg and surface ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: c1
tokens.usage: Series 1 — orange. The protagonist of a diagram (the thing the essay is about). Marks and strokes; label in ink.

tokens.name: c2
tokens.usage: Series 2 — blue. Darkest of the hues in light mode.

tokens.name: c3
tokens.usage: Series 3 — teal-green.

tokens.name: c4
tokens.usage: Series 4 — ochre. Lightest hue; reads apart from c1 by lightness under deuteranopia.

tokens.name: c5
tokens.usage: Series 5 — mauve.

tokens.name: c6
tokens.usage: Series 6 — graphite. Baseline / 'everything else'. Use a dashed stroke so it never reads as plain ink or line.

tokens.name: c1-soft
tokens.usage: Fill tint for c1 shapes; ink text on it.

tokens.name: c2-soft
tokens.usage: Fill tint for c2 shapes; ink text on it.

tokens.name: c3-soft
tokens.usage: Fill tint for c3 shapes; ink text on it.

tokens.name: c4-soft
tokens.usage: Fill tint for c4 shapes; ink text on it.

tokens.name: c5-soft
tokens.usage: Fill tint for c5 shapes; ink text on it. (Extra to the kit's list.)

tokens.name: c6-soft
tokens.usage: Fill tint for c6 shapes; ink text on it. (Extra to the kit's list.)

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: How a Pod finds a home
styles.usage: Hero title only. Sentence case; Archivo at font-stretch 112%. 36/38 on mobile.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heads, preceded by a mono § numeral in accent. 26/30 on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A Deployment never touches a node directly.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.sample: What actually happens between kubectl apply and a running container.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kickers, figure numbers, widget headers, check labels. ink-3 or accent.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions' mono parts, SVG direct labels, meta row.

tokens.name: sp-half
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon-to-label, chip padding-block.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls; caption offset from figure.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between related items; option-button padding.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding on mobile; paragraph spacing (≈ one line).

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding desktop; space above h3.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Gap between widget header and body.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Space above h2; gutter between figure and prose.

tokens.name: sp-7
tokens.usage: Hero inner spacing.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Space around figures and widgets in the prose column.

tokens.name: sp-9
tokens.usage: Section break.

tokens.name: sp-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding mobile.

tokens.name: sp-11
tokens.usage: Hero top padding desktop.

tokens.name: sp-12
tokens.usage: Page bottom / end-of-essay rule.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, panels, figure plates, inputs. Nearly square on purpose.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Small chips and the readout well.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Pills only: status tags, the meta-row time chip.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Hard offset plate shadow — the only shadow. Widgets and check cards; never on prose figures.
